name: Azure OpenAI
tagline: Microsoft-hosted OpenAI models via Azure with enterprise security and regional deployment
description: Azure OpenAI Service provides REST APIs for GPT, embeddings, and other OpenAI models hosted on Microsoft Azure. Developers call resource-specific endpoints with an API key or Microsoft Entra ID, choosing deployment names, regions, and compliance options not available on the public OpenAI API.

auth.details: API key via api-key header (or Microsoft Entra ID Bearer token); keys from Azure portal resource

pricing.paid_plans: Pay-as-you-go per 1K tokens by model; also PTUs and provisioned capacity

rate_limits: Per-deployment TPM/RPM quotas vary by model and region; not a single global limit
use_cases: run chat completions with a deployed GPT model
generate embeddings for RAG or search
transcribe or translate audio with Whisper
moderate content with Azure OpenAI safety APIs
